# TimeToInbox

> TimeToInbox explains time to inbox (TTI), the time from sending an email to its arrival in the recipient's inbox: what it measures, how to measure it yourself, what slows delivery down, and how Forward Email publishes its own TTI measurements and the public source code behind them.

TimeToInbox is a free, static reference site run by the Forward Email team. Each page below has a Markdown copy (linked here) next to its HTML version. The full text of every page is in [llms-full.txt](https://timetoinbox.com/llms-full.txt).

## Guides

- [Time to Inbox (TTI): How Fast Email Reaches the Inbox](https://timetoinbox.com/index.md): Overview of time to inbox, a table of common delay sources with primary sources, and links to every guide.
- [What Is Time to Inbox (TTI)?](https://timetoinbox.com/what-is-time-to-inbox.md): Definition of time to inbox, where the measurement starts and stops, and a comparison table with delivery rate, inbox placement, bounce rate and time to acceptance.
- [How to Measure Time to Inbox](https://timetoinbox.com/how-to-measure-time-to-inbox.md): Two methods to measure TTI: reading Received headers for a single message, and an automated seed-mailbox monitor with a short Node.js example.
- [What Affects Email Delivery Speed](https://timetoinbox.com/what-affects-email-delivery-speed.md): Causes of slow email delivery (greylisting, retry queues, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, reputation, rate limits, volume, forwarding, mail app fetch schedules) with RFC and vendor sources.
- [How Forward Email Measures Time to Inbox](https://timetoinbox.com/forward-email-time-to-inbox.md): Walkthrough of Forward Email's public TTI monitor (jobs/tti.js): providers tested, direct and forwarded paths, IMAP polling, timing, alerts, and where results are published.
- [Time to Inbox FAQ](https://timetoinbox.com/faq.md): Frequently asked questions about time to inbox and delayed email, with short answers.

## Forward Email sources

- [Forward Email live TTI page](https://forwardemail.net/tti): current direct and forwarding delivery times to test inboxes at major mailbox providers, plus a 24-hour chart.
- [TTI monitor source code (jobs/tti.js)](https://github.com/forwardemail/forwardemail.net/blob/master/jobs/tti.js): the job that sends the test messages and records how long they take to arrive.
- [IMAP polling helper (helpers/get-message.js)](https://github.com/forwardemail/forwardemail.net/blob/master/helpers/get-message.js): how the monitor detects that a test message has arrived.
- [Forward Email FAQ: greylisting](https://forwardemail.net/faq#do-you-have-a-greylist): how Forward Email delays mail from new senders.

## Optional

- [About TimeToInbox](https://timetoinbox.com/about.md): Who runs the site, how to contact the team or report an error, the source code, and the privacy note.
- [Privacy Policy](https://timetoinbox.com/privacy.md): Privacy policy: no cookies, analytics, trackers, JavaScript or third-party requests; hosted on GitHub Pages and served through Cloudflare.
- [Source code for this site](https://github.com/forwardemail/timetoinbox.com): static HTML generated by a small Node.js script.
